'''Zelcomm Tower''' was a [[Skyscraper/Legends|skyscraper]] that was situated in [[Sector 1265]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The tower served as the headquarters of [[Zelcomm Industries]], a shipping company that ferried goods between the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. However, the company was a facade that existed to conceal an illegal weapons [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operation that was directed by the [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] [[Coruum Sa'dia]], and the tower acted as the hub from while Sa'dia administered his illicit business. During the reign of the Empire, after the [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Kaa'to Leeachos]] incurred the ire of the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]], a group of Pyke-affiliated agents infiltrated Zelcomm Tower while searching for information on Leeachos' activities.<ref name="UABS" />
